chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: Steele and the Barron Wilkins and Jack Legs Diamond killings
summary: Steele worked at Barron Wilkins's club when Charleston killed Wilkins, and had to flee to Albany after he witnessed a gangland shooting.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Who was who. He was working in Barron Wilkins' joint as a waiter when Charleston killed Barron Wilkins. Barron Wilkins had the big nightclub where Ethel Waters and them went, on 135th Street. And his brother had Wilkins' on the other side of the street, that was one of the greatest nightclubs in New York -- but he didn't allow no White folks in this club. The White folks would go up to Barron Wilkins' club and say, "Let's go... Why can't we go to the other place where they're swingin' over there?" He'd say, "No, my brother don't have no White folks comin' in." No, you come to the door and ask permission, want to pay money to come in. He said, "No, I can't go to your club; don't you set foot in mine."

That's the Wilkins that you hear some (?) people talk about of that particular time. Well, Steele(?) worked there, and he tells me that. So he was in the... what's it's name seat... The Hot Seat? No, not the Hot Seat. I'll get the name of the club. He was in a club when Jack "Legs" Diamond killed another gangster. He was on the stand. And the last thing they saw when the guy was going out, they saw Steele(?) lookin' at 'em. When they shot the gangster and they were going out, the gangsters looked around and they saw Steele(?) lookin' at 'em. So they

watched the papers. And Steele(?) said he went in... So they closed the pub down and left these drums in there. The police made him get out after the killing, see. So he goes home. So he gets phone calls. They wanted him to play somewhere. He said he wouldn't take no chances. So he said they found his house, and then he had to stay inside for about a month, because the gangsters would come around and ask guys to book Steele(?) again, because they figured Steele(?) would describe them -- and they were going to kill him. So he said he left and he went to Albany, and he stayed up there for about a year, while the thing blew over. That was the end of that club. The club that Jack "Legs" Diamond and them killed...
